title: Desert Oasis Mandala
description: A circular mandala-style painting features a vibrant desert landscape at its center with a lone tree, stone path, reflective pool, purple flowers, sand dunes, and distant buildings under a bright yellow sun. The scene is enclosed by concentric red, tan, and black rings adorned with floating blue and purple crystal-like shards.
prompt: Circular mandala composition with a desert oasis scene inside, featuring a lone black tree with exposed roots next to a reflective pool showing the sun's reflection, purple flowers and blue lotuses in the foreground, sand dunes, a stone path leading to buildings on both sides, dramatic sunset sky with a bright glowing sun, all enclosed in concentric red and tan rings with floating blue and purple crystal shards, vibrant folk art style on black background
